body: I glance around nervously, noticing faces in unfamiliar places staring at me curiously. My heart races as I realize this might be an opportunity for some kind of training or orientation. "Hello," I blurt out, hoping my voice sounds calm despite my fluttering nerves. The people around me seem slightly less suspicious now, their eyes narrowing a little more into cautious glances.
full:
I glance around nervously, noticing faces in unfamiliar places staring at me curiously. My heart races as I realize this might be an opportunity for some kind of training or orientation. "Hello," I blurt out, hoping my voice sounds calm despite my fluttering nerves. The people around me seem slightly less suspicious now, their eyes narrowing a little more into cautious glances.

Next: stay beside them and keep them steady.
